thread:
Alice M: Hey team - multiple hosted customers hitting 503s for the past ~25m. Support flagged ~30% request error rate to /v1/generate on model-group:rw-nano-q4. Logs show repeated inference-worker exits and container restarts. Ticket #C-7821.
Ben I: Thanks. I'm seeing crash loops on a subset of infer nodes in us-west-2. Pod logs show SIGSEGV + gpu driver messages.
Carla O: @Ben I can you paste the pod log? also which GPU type?
Ben I: pod: infer-runner-5f7c9-ztl2 (node gpu-a100-2). tail from container:
```
I0503 15:12:02.123 12345 run.cpp:421] starting inference loop
E0503 15:12:12.456 12345 cuda_driver.cc:78] NVML: uncorrectable ECC error on GPU 0
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
--- container restart ---
```
Ben I: NVML ECC uncorrectable reported immediately before segfault.
Evelyn S: NVML ECC -> possible hardware issue or a driver regression. Did we deploy any kernel/driver changes in the last 24h?
Dan R: We pushed a quantized runtime change yesterday for q4_0 kernels; it landed in the nightly build at 02:00 PST. Could be interacting with memory layout or nvml calls.
Alice M: Customer impact high. One enterprise reported 15% of requests failing, showing 503 -> "upstream inference error" in our gateway.
support-bot: Customer ACME is on the escalation list. Notified account team.
oncall-bot: Pager duty alert sent to oncall SRE team (carla).
Carla O: Running a quick correlation: all failing pods are on nodes with driver 525.90.15. Nodes with 525.85.x are fine.
Ben I: Can reproduce locally on a dev node by firing a short high-concurrency test hitting the quantized model. After ~200 concurrent requests some processes segfault. Stack shows crash in aten::native op (attention kernel).
Dan R: Repro steps from my dev run:
1) checkout release/quant-runtime@f32a8
2) build with QKERNELS=1
3) run load test: `siege -c200 -t30S http://localhost:8080/v1/generate`
Got identical segfault after ~90s.
Evelyn S: We should avoid mass customer impact. Temporary mitigation options: 1) route traffic to non-quantized model variant (rw-nano-f32), 2) evict pods from nodes with 525.90.15, 3) scale dedicated pool up and route. Which is fastest?
Alice M: 1 and 3 combined. Can we add a routing override to send hosted requests for model-group:rw-nano-q4 -> rw-nano-f32?
Ben I: Yes - adding a policy in routing service now. Patch: `route override add --model-group rw-nano-q4 --fallback rw-nano-f32 --duration 2h`
Ben I: Pushed policy, canary at 15%. Monitoring errors.
Carla O: Also isolating problematic nodes: marking them cordoned for kured/drain. `kubectl cordon gpu-a100-2-0` then draining non-critical pods. Will schedule node-replace.
Alice M: Support update to customers: "We identified upstream inference worker crashes caused by NVML ECC + a recent quantized runtime change. We are routing traffic to a non-quantized variant while we remediate. Expect reduced latency but same model semantics."
Dan R: Root cause narrow: quantized attention kernel + driver 525.90.15 triggers an unprotected nvml call that surfaces as ECC error then segfault. There are two fixes: guard nvml calls and patch kernel memory access. Guard is quick.
Evelyn S: Agree. Patch incoming to runtime to check nvml return codes and skip ECC queries when driver reports unrecoverable. Start rollout to canary nodes (5%).
Ben I: Patch applied to canary. Logs show no ECC queries now and no segfaults in 10m of high-concurrency tests.
Carla O: Scaling note: some customers on dedicated have pinned variants that can't be auto-failed over. For them we need to notify account teams and offer capacity migration.
Alice M: Can we craft repro steps for engineering to reproduce in lab? Put in quick ticket.
Dan R: Repro ticket: REPRO-9982. Steps + test script attached. Script gist: curl loop with concurrency, precondition set driver to 525.90 (or emulate), run quant build.
```
# repro script (simplified)
for i in {1..500}; do curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' &
done
wait
```
Evelyn S: Post-mitigation plan: 1) rollback driver to 525.85 for affected pools OR 2) release runtime patch v0.12.3 with guards + kernel fix. Recommend patching runtime and scheduling driver rollback in parallel for extra safety.
support-bot: Notified customers with status update. ACME confirmed they see reduced 503s.
Carla O: Node replacements kicking off. Observability: error rate dropped from 32% -> 4% after routing override.
Ben I: Follow-up: captured core dump, uploaded to artifact store at s3://redwood-infer-debug/2071234567/core-infer-runner-5f7c9.tar.gz. Shared with Debug team.
Dan R: Preparing PR for guarded nvml calls: link https://github.com/redwood/infer-runtime/pull/728 (contains unit tests).
Alice M: Good work. I'll draft the post-incident note and customer-facing timeline. Add timeline: detection 15:10, mitigation routing 15:38, runtime hotfix v0.12.3 canary 16:05, full rollout scheduled 17:00.
Evelyn S: After full rollout we should run a 1hr soak test at 3x normal concurrency. Also add regression alert for segfault rate on attention kernels.
Carla O: Closing loop with infra - replacement nodes reported no further ECC events.
Ben I: Marking incident as mitigated. Will keep thread open until runtime patch verified in prod. :white_check_mark:
Alice M: Thanks everyone. I'll update the incident channel with the final postmortem once drafted. :memo:
